# CANDIDATE: vol_expansion_ratio

**Filed:** 2026-06-29
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The `vol_expansion_ratio` primitive can add edge to the existing `vol>=1.3x-of-20-bar-MA` check by identifying red breakdown bars with a volume expansion ratio of 1.5x or more, which could indicate a higher likelihood of a successful trade.

## Mechanism

The `vol_expansion_ratio` primitive will be implemented in `crypto/lib` as a testable, pure function. It will calculate the volume expansion ratio by dividing the current bar's volume by the median volume of the past 5 bars. The primitive will then be used to filter red breakdown bars with a volume expansion ratio of 1.5x or more.
